name: koala-outcome-semantics-dashboard
title: Koala outcome semantics and dashboard clarity
description: C2 feedback showed Koala story DONE percentage can be mistaken for technical completion, blocked spike stories are forced into happy-path pass/fail evidence language, and worktree/main phase authority text feels alarming. Add explicit completion outcome semantics so DONE-success, DONE-blocked, and DONE-audit-only are visible without weakening gates, plus verdict-style evidence for classified blocked spikes.
